# Mordman

> Mordman is a five-piece cover band from Gavle, Sweden, playing energetic rock and pop hits from the 80s, 90s, and 2000s at weddings, corporate events, birthday parties, and club nights.

## Facts

- Type: Cover band / party band / live band
- Location: Based in Gavle, Sweden. Also plays in Uppsala, Sandviken, Dalarna, Stockholm, and elsewhere.
- Genre: Rock, pop, alternative — covers from the 80s onward
- Size: Five members
- Business: Mordman Handelsbolag, org.nr 969803-8123 (Swedish partnership with F-skattesedel)
- Contact: boka@mordman.se
- Website: https://www.mordman.se
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mordman.band/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61579179277781

## What they offer

- Live music for private parties (30th, 40th, 50th birthdays), weddings, corporate events, and pub/club nights
- Full sound and lighting equipment included in the booking
- Flexible setlist adapted to the client's preferences
- Proper invoicing with F-skattesedel (Swedish tax registration)

## Artists in their repertoire

Foo Fighters, Blink-182, The Killers, Audioslave, The Hellacopters, Queens of the Stone Age, Nothing But Thieves, The Hives, The Smashing Pumpkins, Red Hot Chili Peppers, The White Stripes, Priestess, KISS, Millencolin, Turbonegro, Paramore, Kings of Leon, Rage Against the Machine, Blur, Franz Ferdinand, Black Sabbath, Ozzy Osbourne, Nirvana, Band of Horses, Wolfmother, Royal Blood.

## Booking

Email boka@mordman.se with date, venue, and approximate format. Pricing depends on travel distance, sound/lighting needs, and set length.

## Not to be confused with

Nordman — a Swedish folk-rock duo. Mordman is a separate, unrelated band.
